item.title: Yacht Club de Monaco to host elite Superyacht Chef Competition
item.description: Monaco's Yacht Club de Monaco will host the seventh edition of its Superyacht Chef Competition on the 2nd of April, uniting some of the world's finest culinary talents to compete in a unique setting.

item.title: Monaco’s Top Marques to return with its largest edition to date
item.description: Top Marques Monaco will come back to the Grimaldi Forum this spring, with what organisers promise to be the largest edition yet.

item.title: Zenirō: Nice’s stunning new Japanese-Provençal restaurant worth leaving Monaco for
item.description: Sophisticated yet accessible, Zenirō is worth the trip from Monaco, a destination in its own right from Nice, and a standout new opening combining refined cooking, elegant design and excellent value.

item.title: Monaco pour ‘Emploi sees record turnout with tech taking centre stage
item.description: Key government ministers officially opened the fourth edition of Monaco pour l'Emploi Friday morning at the Grimaldi Forum, with this edition marking its biggest turnout to date.

item.title: Harry Potter returns to Paris: 25 years of magic celebrated with spectacular events
item.description: The French capital prepares for an exceptional year of festivities marking a quarter-century since the wizarding world first enchanted cinema audiences.

item.title: Monte-Carlo Television Festival opens Golden Nymph Awards submissions with revamped categories
item.description: The Monte-Carlo Television Festival is accepting entries for its 65th edition, which runs from 12th to 16th June, with notable changes to its competition categories reflecting shifts in how audiences consume content.

item.title: Formula E supercharges AI partnership with Google Cloud to revolutionise racing
item.description: 17:05Formula E elevates Google Cloud to Principal AI Partner in expanded deal using Gemini models to transform race operations, fan experience and slash carbon footprint through digital twins and virtual site optimization.

item.title: Volkswagen overtakes Tesla as Europe’s top electric car seller
item.description: Volkswagen has dethroned Tesla as Europe's best-selling electric vehicle brand, marking another setback for Elon Musk's automaker following its loss of global EV leadership to China's BYD last year.

item.title: Women of Monaco Awards return for fifth edition celebrating achievement across eight categories
item.description: The Women of Monaco Lunch and Awards returns on 12 March at the Yacht Club, celebrating female achievement across eight categories while supporting the Princess Grace Foundation.

item.title: Football: Monaco’s struggles continue in Côte d’Azur derby draw to Nice
item.description: Following their elimination from the Coupe de France in midweek, AS Monaco's struggles continued as they were held by OGC Nice in the Côte d'Azur derby on Sunday (0-0).
